components.css: .ds-workload-panel { position: sticky; top: 84px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d8e0ea; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-workload-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 20px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8e0ea; } .ds-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-stat { padding: 17px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8e0ea; } .ds-stat.ds-is-emphasized { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding-block: 21px; background: #ebdafd; } .ds-stat-label { margin: 0; color: #6b7589; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stat-value { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font: 600 29px/1 Bricolage Grotesque, sans-serif; } .ds-filters { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; } .ds-filter-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; } .ds-filter-label { width: 100%; color: #6b7589; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-filter-chip { padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #111827; border-radius: 9px; background: #111827; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Primary button

components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-button-primary { background: #862fe7; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: rgba(11, 61, 121, 0.16) 0 0 0 1px inset; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #5f259e; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview: Effi's officer console is a bright, compact workspace for scanning live civic cases. Supahub's violet, Bricolage Grotesque headings, Inter UI text, and friendly geometry remain recognizable. The dashboard puts those traits to work through a sticky workload rail, a case ledger, clear status language, and actions that remain visible while an officer scans. This is an operational interface, not a marketing page. White and fog organize the desk. Violet marks the brand, live data, and primary action. Borders carry most of the structure, while rounded corners soften the interface without turning every row into a card.
keyCharacteristics: Bright white canvas with one violet accent.
Dense ledger rows with operational metadata visible at a glance.
Sticky workload and filters on wide screens.
Complete loading, empty, access, and query-error states.
Responsive records that keep the Open action visible.

rules.name: The one-accent rule
rules.body: Violet carries brand and action. Pink and amber orb colors from the marketing reference do not belong in dashboard layouts.

rules.name: The handoff rule
rules.body: Bricolage names the page or state. Inter carries the officer through the work.

rules.name: The ledger stays grounded
rules.body: Never add shadows between case rows or lift every workload statistic into its own card.

dos: Do keep workload and filters in the sticky rail on wide screens.
Do keep report number, channel, status, relative time, and Open visible in each case record.
Do use borders and quiet fills to separate dashboard regions.
Do preserve visible focus and text labels for every status.
Do build loading and empty layouts from the same structure as loaded content.
donts: Don't turn the dashboard into a marketing composition with gradient orbs, hero bands, floating mockups, or card grids.
Don't use Bricolage for ledger text, filters, metadata, or controls.
Don't add a new accent or use pink and amber as operational states.
Don't hide the Open action or core metadata at narrow widths.
Don't put every count, row, or filter inside a separate rounded card.
Don't invent dashboard records or metrics. Every value comes from Convex.
